title: macrotyloma geocarpum
intro: Macrotyloma geocarpum, commonly known as Horse gram, is a perennial legume plant native to India and other parts of the Indian subcontinent. It is rich in nutrients and has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and managing diabetes. The therapeutic actions of Horse gram include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as phenolic acids, flavonoids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Horse gram have been found to possess anti-diabetic, anti-cancer, and anti-cardiovascular disease properties, making it a valuable plant for medicinal purposes.
